title: PSC Master's Scholarships
program_type: Government postgraduate scholarship for the Singapore Public Service, Public Administration track
duration: Maximum 2 years of study in any country, followed by a 3-year bond
description: The PSC Master's Scholarships are postgraduate awards for those who wish to pursue a Master's degree and a career in Public Administration and Sustainability in the Singapore Public Service. Applicants choose between the PSC Master's Scholarship and the PSC Master's Scholarship (Sustainability). The award covers tuition fees and other approved charges, return airfare for overseas degrees, maintenance and other allowances, and a series of sponsored development programmes including student exchange and summer opportunities. title: MOE Teaching Scholarships/Award (Full-Term)
program_type: Teaching scholarship and award for entry to the Singapore Education Service, undergraduate
duration: Full-time undergraduate degree; bond of 4 years for local studies, 5 years for non-English speaking countries, 6 years for English speaking countries, plus a concurrent 3-year PGDE bond at NIE for those who take the Postgraduate Diploma in Education
description: The MOE Teaching Scholarships/Award (Full-Term) sponsors Singaporean school leavers through a full-time undergraduate degree so that they can enter the Education Service as teachers. Applicants may be offered either an Education Merit Scholarship or Teaching Scholarship administered by the Public Service Commission, or a Teaching Award administered by MOE, and are considered for the full range. title: NUS Undergraduate Scholarship (NUS Scholarships for Freshmen, Singapore Citizens)
official_source: National University of Singapore, Office of Admissions
duration: Tenable for the normal candidature period of the degree, renewed every semester
description: NUS offers Singapore Citizen freshmen a single common scholarship application covering the Global Merit, Merit, Undergraduate, AI Talent, Sports and Performing & Visual Arts Scholarships for AY2027. Scholars receive 100% tuition fee coverage after the MOE Tuition Grant subsidy, are bond-free, and get a guaranteed one-semester exchange placement. Applications run 1 February to 19 March 2027.
